title: Wispweed
summary: Extract three Wispweeds for Potion of Glorious Vaulting.

fields.Alchemy: Extract three Wispweeds into Sublimate of Wispweed. Add any Ash to craft one Potion of Glorious Vaulting.
fields.Acquisition: Derryth Bonecloak in the Myconid Colony or random loot.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
